origin.description: Return the 1-based positions that sort a character vector.
origin.usage: str_order(x, decreasing = FALSE, na_last = TRUE, locale = "en", numeric = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: FALSE, the default, orders from lowest to highest. TRUE orders from highest to lowest.

arguments.name: na_last
arguments.text: TRUE puts NA at the end, FALSE puts NA at the beginning, and NA drops missing strings from the permutation.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en" so English collation is the same on every platform.

arguments.name: numeric
arguments.text: TRUE orders digit runs as numbers. FALSE, the default, orders them as text.
Further collator settings, passed to stringi::stri_opts_collator().

origin.details: The positions are a stable permutation: x[str_order(x)] is str_sort(x). Equal strings keep their original order. The default locale is English. In Czech, ch sorts after h.
origin.value: An integer vector of 1-based positions. NULL and an empty vector are integer(0).

translation.description: Return the 1-based positions that sort a character vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those. None is an empty result.

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: False orders from lowest to highest. True orders from highest to lowest.

arguments.name: na_last
arguments.text: True puts NA at the end, False puts NA at the beginning, and NA drops missing strings.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en".

arguments.name: numeric
arguments.text: True orders digit runs as numbers. False orders them as text.

translation.details: Calls stri_order. Indexing the original vector with these positions reproduces str_sort, including a leading U+FEFF. The default locale is English.
translation.value: A list of 1-based integers. An empty input is an empty list.
